decisions.finding: P1 transient exception with function/BigInt in server JSON can permanently strand lease
decisions.reason: The actual server read layer parses bounded UTF8 JSON. Functions and BigInt cannot arrive from JSON.parse; lone surrogates stringify normally. A crash may leave the explicit run pending, which is intentionally not auto-replayed. The existing abort API/UI closes it without network, preserves the completed prefix and marks only the remaining suffix unknown. Actual API and timeout/oversize tests confirm reservation release. This is recoverable, not permanent, and the proposed impossible-input reproduction is not a production counterexample.
